How do you make the perfect grilled cheese sandwich?

get some good quality bread, I personally love some sourdough for my grilled cheese.

quality cheeses that melt well. Cheddar, muenster, provolone and swiss are excellent choices. Use all 4 for extra bomb-ness.

butter the bread on the side that will touch the pan.

sear it on the pan, low heat so the bread doesn't burn and the cheese melts and wait until each side is golden.

bam, you have a delicious grilled cheese sandwich.

Add bacon or avocado for extra deliciousness, add meat and call it a melt if that's what you fancy.
+1 on the bacon. Adding apple is also a nice touch as well.
